extra.message: Hardcoded username 'admin' and password 'password123' are embedded in source code. These credentials are used for application authentication and can be easily discovered by anyone with access to the code or compiled artifacts.

The session cookie is set without HttpOnly, Secure, or SameSite flags. This makes the cookie accessible to JavaScript and vulnerable to theft via XSS, and it may be sent over unencrypted connections.

extra.message: The session cookie value 'user' is retrieved on line 46 and interpolated into an f-string HTML response without escaping or sanitization. An attacker who controls the cookie value can inject arbitrary JavaScript, resulting in stored XSS when the dashboard is rendered.

The search query parameter 'q' is read from the URL on line 52 and interpolated directly into an f-string HTML response without escaping. An attacker can craft a malicious URL containing JavaScript that executes in the victim's browser when visited.
